verdict.rationale: Kick documents a double-entry ledger whose Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet are built from the chart of accounts. The P&L updates in real time, the CLI can pull financial statements, and locked-period reports stay stable, so two of the three statements are evidenced with accuracy controls. A cash-flow statement is never mentioned, and arbitrary-period on-demand generation is only implied. Missing for 10: any evidence of a cash-flow statement, explicit custom date-range selection for statements, and independent or hands-on corroboration of statement accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand

citations.quote: Your Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet are organized by the accounts in your CoA.
Your Profit & Loss updates in real time as transactions are categorized.
pull transactions or financial statements with the Kick CLI
Reports for locked periods remain accurate and stable.
A journal entry is a double-entry record with two sides: a debit and a credit.
